title: Bubble Art
body:
Goal: finish a Bubble class and use it to paint a picture full of bubbles. Each bubble is an object that remembers its own x, y, size and color.

  1. Open starter.py in Thonny.
  2. Finish the TODOs: __init__, grow, move, the big dot in draw, and make_bubbles.
  3. Press Run. A black window fills with 40 colorful bubbles, each with a little white shine.

Extra: add a method pop(self, t) that draws a ring of small dots around the bubble, or make bubbles near the top of the screen bigger.

hints.label: Hint 1
hints.title: Where to look
hints.html: Start at the top of the Bubble class and work down through the TODOs in order. A bubble must remember its own numbers, so the first job is in __init__. Look at how self.x is already saved.

hints.label: Hint 2
hints.title: Try this
hints.html: Inside a class, self.name = value saves a value on that one object. To change a saved number, set it to its old value plus something. For make_bubbles, use for _ in range(____): and random.randint(low, high) for each number.

hints.label: Hint 3
hints.title: Almost there
hints.html: Follow this pattern: self.size = self.size + ____. In __init__, write self.color = ____ using the parameter with the same name. For the dot, call t.dot(____, ____). In the loop, make x, y, size and color, then bubbles.append(Bubble(____)).

starter.name: starter.py
starter.raw:
# Bubble Art - YOUR version
# Each Bubble object remembers its own position, size and color.
# The draw method uses a turtle to paint the bubble on the screen.
# Finish the TODOs, then press Run and see if it does what the README says.

import random
import turtle

PALETTE = ["#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
           "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"]


class Bubble:
    """Blueprint for one bubble."""

    def __init__(self, x, y, size, color):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y
        # TODO 1: remember size and color too (self.size = ..., self.color = ...)

    def grow(self, amount):
        """Make the bubble bigger."""
        # TODO 2: add amount to self.size
        pass

    def move(self, dx, dy):
        """Slide the bubble by dx (right) and dy (up)."""
        # TODO 3: add dx to self.x and dy to self.y
        pass

    def draw(self, t):
        """Paint the bubble: a big dot plus a small white shine."""
        t.penup()
        t.goto(self.x, self.y)
        # TODO 4: draw a dot of size self.size in self.color
        #         hint: t.dot(size, color)
        t.goto(self.x - 10, self.y + 10)
        t.dot(10, "white")


def make_bubbles(count):
    """Return a list of count Bubble objects in random places."""
    bubbles = []
    # TODO 5: repeat count times: pick a random x (-300 to 300), y (-200 to 200),
    #         size (20 to 80) and color (random.choice(PALETTE)),
    #         then append Bubble(x, y, size, color) to bubbles.
    return bubbles


def draw_all(bubbles, t):
    """Ask every bubble to draw itself. (Already done!)"""
    for bubble in bubbles:
        bubble.draw(t)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    screen = turtle.Screen()
    screen.title("Bubble Art")
    screen.bgcolor("black")
    screen.tracer(0)  # draw everything at once
    pen = turtle.Turtle()
    pen.hideturtle()

    bubbles = make_bubbles(40)
    for bubble in bubbles:
        if bubble.size < 40:
            bubble.grow(10)  # small bubbles grow a little
        bubble.move(0, 30)   # every bubble floats up
    draw_all(bubbles, pen)
    screen.update()
    turtle.done()
